Kana masikweya ose aine ruvara rwenhamba yawo, gridhi ndiyo ndima iri papepa. Masikweya akazadzwa neimwe ruvara chero ipi zvayo ndiro ndima yako chaiyo, uye mutambo hautauri chinhu nezvazvo. "Zadza nenhamba" inozadza masikweya ose asina chinhu.
howTo: Sarudza saizi yegridhi. 4 by 4 ine masikweya akakura kwazvo uye ndiyo iri nyore kwazvo.
Tarisa kiyi iri pamusoro pegridhi. Ruvara rwega rwega rune nhamba uye zita, semuenzaniso 1 Yellow.
Pinza ruvara mukiyi, wobva wapinza masikweya waunoda kuzadza nairo.
Shandisa ruvara rwenhamba, kana ruvara rwupi zvarwo rwaunoda. Zvese zvakanaka.
Pinza "Zadza nenhamba" kuti uzadze masikweya asina chinhu, "Bvisa" kuti utange gridhi patsva, kana "Imwe ndima" kuti uwane imwe.
tips: Garai pedyo nepedyo muchitendeuka: mumwe munhu anosarudza ruvara, mumwe anopinza masikweya.
Taurai nezvemavara: "Ndinoda girini." Hapana chinodikanwa chekutaura kuti ndima ichava chii.
Paskrini duku, gridhi ye 8 by 8 inotsvedza kurudyi nekuseri mubhokisi rayo. Masikweya anoramba ari saizi inogutsa.
Vhezheni yepepa inoshanda zvakare nepenseri patafura pedyo nembeyo.

faq.q: Pane nguva kana mapoinzi here?
faq.a: Hapana. Hapana wachi, mapoinzi, kauntari yekufamba kana kurasikirwa. Unogona kumira nguva ipi neipi, uye kumira pakati pendima chinhu chakanaka chekupedzisa.

faq.q: Ko kana ndikashandisa ruvara rwakasiyana nenhamba?
faq.a: Hapana chinoitika, uye ndizvo zvakakosha. Ruvara rwupi zvarwo runogona kuenda kumasikweya upi zvawo, uye mutambo hautauri chinhu nezvazvo. Kana masikweya ose aine ruvara rwenhamba yawo, mutambo unoudza zvinyoro, uye ndima mumavara ako pachako inokodzera zvakaenzana.

faq.q: Vanhu vane kusaona mavara vanogona kusiyanisa mavara mana here?
faq.a: Akasarudzwa kuti vagone. Ruvara rwega rwega runewo nhamba, zita rakanyorwa uye chimiro chidiki chega, saka ruvara harisi chete nzira yekusiyanisa. Mavara mana akaongororwa nezvifananidzo zvekusaona mavara zvitsvuku-zvirimwe uye zvebhuruu-zvefu, uye akasiyanawo nekujeka. Munhu ane kusaona mavara haana kuedza, saka ndapota tiudze kana maviri akafanana.

faq.q: Masikweya akakura zvakakwana here kune munhu ane kunyeperera kana paskrini diki?
faq.a: Masikweya ega ega ane mapikisero osachepera 48 mukupamhara, uye 56 pagridhi ye 4 by 4. Kana gridhi yakakura zvakanyanya paskrini, inotsvedza kurudyi nekuseri mubhokisi rayo pane kuderedza masikweya.

faq.q: Pane vhezheni yepepa here?
faq.a: Ehe. Pepa rimwe rine gridhi yakanyorwa nhamba uye kiyi yemavara mana nemazita avo. Dhaya sikweya rega rega nepenseri yeruvara rakanyorwa panhamba yaro, kana ruvara rwupi zvarwo rwaunoda.

faq.q: Ko zvinoda mari here, uye ndinofanira kunyoresa?
faq.a: Ehe, mahara, uye hapana akaunzi, kunyoresa kana kudhawunirodha. Inoshanda pawebhusaiti yebhurawuzi pafoni, pathabhureti kana pakombiyuta.

pattern-maker.name: Pattern maker
pattern-maker.seoTitle: Pattern Maker: Gadzira Tairo uye Dhinda Chirongwa
pattern-maker.h1: Pattern Maker: Gadzira Tairo, Ona Richidzokorora
pattern-maker.description: Shandura masikweya etairo diki rimwe chete uye ona richidzokorora kuva chirongwa chiri pedyo, rine mavara mana ega ega ane zita nechimiro. Hapana nguva kana mapoinzi. Mutambo wamahara uye unogona kudhindwa.
pattern-maker.short: Shandura masikweya etairo diki uone richidzokorora kuva chirongwa.
pattern-maker.intro: Tairo diki re masikweya 3 by 3, kana 4 by 4 kana uchida, uye pedyo nayo "chirongwa chako": tairo imwe chete inodzokororwa mubhuroko. Pinza sikweya rimwe chete rinoshandurwa kuva rinotevera pamavara mana, imwe neimwe ine zita rayo rakanyorwa uye chimiro chayo. Chirongwa chiri pedyo chinoshanduka ipapo ipapo. Hapana chirongwa chakanaka chakanyanya uye hapana chinochengetwa kana kutumirwa. "Dhinda chirongwa changu" inoisa chirongwa chakadzokororwa papeji imwe kuti uchengete, udhaye kana kupa mumwe munhu.
howTo: Tarisa tairo nechirongwa chako chiri pedyo nayo. Ndiyo tairo imwe chete, yakadzokororwa.
Pinza sikweya. Rinoshandurwa kuva ruvara rwakatevera mumutsara wemavara mana ari kumusoro.
Ramba uchipinza masikweya kusvikira chirongwa chinoita sezvaunoda. Chirongwa chero chipi chinonaka.
Pinza "Ndishamise" kuti utore tairo nyowani, kana "Tanga zvakare" kuti utange tairo isina chinhu. "Dzosera" inodzosera tairo waive nayo.
Pinza "Dhinda chirongwa changu" kana uchida papepa, kana pinza Zorora kuti umise.
tips: Sit side by side and take turns: one person taps a square, the other says what they notice.
Talk about what you see: "Ndiyo imba inoita sekuona kunge ruva." There is no need to name anything.
Try the same tile in just two colors, then again in all four.
On paper, the pattern can be colored in with pencils, cut into strips for a card, or used to wrap a small gift.

faq.q: Pane nguva kana mbiri here?
faq.a: Hapana. Hapana wachi, mbiri, kauntaro yekufamba kana kurasikirwa. Unogona kumira nguva ipi neipi, uye kumira pakati pebasa igwaro rakanaka rekupedzisa.

faq.q: Chinhu chandinoita chinochengetwa here kana kutumirwa?
faq.a: Kwete. Tairo yako inogara peji iri chete. Haichengetwi, haisvikwi pasi kana kuverengwa, uye inopera kana wavhara peji. Kana uchida kuchengeta chitsauko, chidhindise.

faq.q: Ko kana ukadzvanya bhokisi risiri raro kana kubvisa tairo nekukanganwa?
faq.a: Hapana bhokisi risiri raro: ridzvanyezve kuti uende kumavara akatevera. Mushure me"Tanga zvakare" kana "Ndishamisei", "Dzosa" inodzosa tairo yaimbova nayo.

faq.q: Vanhu vane kusaona mavara vanogona kusiyanisa mavara mana here?
faq.a: Akasarudzwa kuti vagone. Mavara ese ane zita rakanyorwa uye chimiro chawo chidiki mubhokisi rimwe nerimwe, saka ruvara harusi rwega nzira yekusiyanisa. Mavara mana akaongororwa nemifananidzo yekusaona mavara utsvuku-nhema uye buruu-yero. Munhu ane kusaona mavara haana kuedza, saka ndapota tiudze kana maviri akafanana.

faq.q: Mabhokisi akakura sei kuti azive kuti munhu ane kunyungudika muruoko kana screen diki?
faq.a: Bhokisi rega rega rine upamhi hwe56 pixels. Kana tairo yakakura zvakanyanya kune screen, inofamba kurutivi mukati mebhokisi rayo kwete kuderedza mabhokisi.

faq.q: Pane vhezheni yepepa here?
faq.a: Ehe. "Dhinda pateni yangu" inodhinda pateni yawakaita papeji rimwe, nemavara mana nemazita awo, zvakanaka mutsvuku uye chena nekuti ruvara rega rega rine chimiro charo.

faq.q: Haina mari here, uye ndinoda kunyoresa here?
faq.a: Ehe, haina mari, uye hapana akaunti, kunyoresa kana kudhawunirodha. Inoshanda mu web browser pafoni, tablet kana komputa.

drawing-duet.name: Drawing duet
drawing-duet.seoTitle: Drawing Duet: Vanhu Vaviri, Pikicha Imwe
drawing-duet.h1: Drawing Duet: Vanhu Vaviri, Pepa Rimwe
drawing-duet.description: Vanhu vaviri vanotsvedzerana kudhirowa mitsara papeji rimwe rakagovaniswa, mumwe nemumwe ane ruvara rwake. Hapana anoverenga mapoinzi kana kukunda, uye pikicha inogona kuchengetwa kana kudhindwa. Inotamba mahara, uye hapana akaunti.
drawing-duet.short: Tsvedzerana kudhirowa pikicha imwe pamwe naniko akagara pedyo newe.
drawing-duet.intro: Kanvasi imwe, vanhu vaviri. Mumwe nemumwe wenyu anosarudza ruvara, uye ruvara rega rega rine zita rarwo rakanyorwa. Munotsvedzerana: dhirowa mutsara kana chimiro chimwe, wobva wapa pen mumwe. Mumwe wenyu anogona kupfuura nguva ipi neipi. Hapana pikicha chaiyo uye hapana mapoinzi. Chengetai pikicha pamudziyo wenyu kana muchida, kana dhindai vhezheni yepepa: pepa rimwe, pen mbiri.
howTo: Mumwe nemumwe wenyu anosarudza ruvara. Bhena rinoratidza kuti ndiani ari kutsvedzerwa, neruvara rwake nezita.
Dhirowa mutsara kana chimiro chimwe nechigoho, mouse kana pen. Kana shandisai mitsara yemuvhi neSpace kuti mudhirowe pasina pointa.
Kana mugadzirira, dzvanya "Pa pen". Mumwe wenyu anogona kupfuura nguva ipi neipi.
Dzvanya "Bvisa mutsara wangu wekupedzisira" kuti ubvise mutsara mutsva wemunhu ari kutsvedzerwa.
Dzvanya "Chengeta pikicha" kuti uite faira repikicha pamudziyo uyu, kana "Dhinda vhezheni yepepa" kuti upe pepa rimwe nepen mbiri.
tips: Gara pedyo uye taurai pamunenge muri kudhirowa: "Ndichawedzera zuva pakona."
Tanga nechitsuwa, mutsara kana chimiro chiri nyore, uye regai munhu wamuri naye apindure.
Hapana anofanira kudhirowa chinhu chiri chose. Pateni yemitsara yakanaka sezvo nyaya yakazara.
Kana muchida kumira, dzvanya "Ndaguta zvangu panguva ino". Pikicha yako haichengetwi mushure mekubuda papeji kunze kwekunge wachengeta.

faq.q: Pane anokunda here kana mapoinzi?
faq.a: Kwete. Hapana anokunda, hapana mapoinzi, hapana nguva yekufamba kana kuverenga kwetsvedzerano. Hapana pikicha chaiyo, uye hapana chinoitwa nhamba kana kuenzaniswa.

faq.q: Pikicha inochengetwa here kana kutumirwa?
faq.a: Kwete, hapana chinotumirwa kwiyi. Pikicha inogara papeji rino kusvikira wavhara. Kana ukadzvanya Chengeta pikicha, faira rinogadzirwa pamudziyo wako kuti uridhawunirodhe. Hapana chinosvikwa pasi.

faq.q: Ndinogona kubvisa mutsara here?
faq.a: Ehe. "Bvisa mutsara wangu wekupedzisira" inobvisa mutsara mutsva wemunhu ari kutsvedzerwa. "Tanga zvakare" inobvisa pepa, uye "Dzosa" inodzosa mitsara, nhanho imwe chete.

faq.q: Ndinogona kushandisa izvi pasina mouse kana touch screen?
faq.a: Ehe. Pakarongwa pikicha, mitsara yemuvhi inofambisa madoro epen, uye kiyi yeSpace inoisa pen pasi kana kuimudza. Screen inoti "Pen down" kana "Pen up" nguva yega yega.

faq.q: Mavara acho ndeupi, uye vanhu vane kusaona mavara vanogona kuasiyanisa here?
faq.a: Yero, orenji, girinhi uye purpure, mavara mana afambiswa mumimwe mapikicha edu. Ega ega ane zita rakanyorwa, uye mazita anoratidzwa pedyo nebasa. Mavara akaongororwa nemifananidzo yemisiyano yekuona mavara yakajairika, asi munhu ane misiyano yekuona mavara haana kuedza.

faq.q: Pane vhezheni yepepa here?
faq.a: Ehe. "Dhinda vhezheni yepepa" inodhinda pepa rimwe rine mirau yacho uye fureme hombe isina chinhu yekudhirowa mukati, vanhu vaviri nepen mbiri. Inoshanda mutsvuku uye chena.

faq.q: Haina mari here, uye ndinoda kunyoresa here?
faq.a: Ee, mahara, hauna akaundi, kunyoreswa kana kudawunirodha. Inoshanda pawebhusaiti yepawebhu pafoni, pathebhureti kana pakombiyuta.

build-together.name: Vakaka pamwe
build-together.seoTitle: Vakaka Pamwe: Vanhu Vaviri Vanovaka Pateni Imwe
build-together.h1: Vakaka Pamwe: Vanhu Vaviri, Gridhi Imwe
build-together.description: Vanhu vaviri vanotsinhira kuisa chidimbu mugridhi yakagovaniswa kusvikira yazara, mumwe nomumwe ane ruvara rwake rune zita nechimiro. Hapana anokunda, uye hapana taimbhi kana mabhodhi. Yakasununguka kutamba uye kudhinda.
build-together.short: Tsinhirai nomumwe muri pedyo kuzadza gridhi imwe yakagovaniswa.
build-together.intro: Gridhi yakagovaniswa ine nzvimbo 4 nenzvimbo 4, kana 3 nenzvimbo 3 kana muchida. Mumwe nomumwe wenyu anosarudza ruvara, uye ruvara rwega rwega rune zita rakanyorwa nechimiro chayo. Munotsinhirana: pakutsinhira kwenyu, tapa nzvimbo isina chinhu kuisa chidimbu chenyu ipapo. Kana nzvimbo dzose dzazara chidimbu, pikicha yavakwa pamwe chete. Hapana anokunda, nekuti munoiita muri vaviri, uye hapana chinochengetwa kana kutumirwa. "Dhinda gridhi" inoisa gridhi isina chinhu pagwaro rimwe kuti mufambe nepensiro mbiri.
howTo: Mumwe nomumwe wenyu asarudza ruvara. Ruvara rwamuri nomumwe muri kushandisa rinoratidzwa se"Riri kushandiswa".
Munhu wekutanga ndiye anotanga. Skirini inoratidza kuti ndiani ane tsinhiro uye ruvara rwake.
Tapa nzvimbo isina chinhu kuisa chidimbu chako ipapo. Tsinhiro inopfuura kumumwe munhu.
Kana usingadi kuisa chidimbu, tapa "Pfuura". Mumwe nomumwe wenyu anogona kupfuura nguva ipi neipi.
Kana nzvimbo dzose dzazara chidimbu, makavaka pikicha pamwe chete. Tapa "Tanga zvakare" kuvaka imwe, kana tapa Zorora kuti umise.
tips: Garai pedyo kuti mose muone uye mugone kusvika pachikuva. Taurai pamusoro pekuita: "Ini ndichaisa yangu pedyo neyako."
Edzai kuvaka pateni, mitsara, chikwenzi kana muganhu, kana kungoisa zvidimbu kwamunoda. Zvese zvakanaka.
Mwana kana munhu anoneta nekukurumidza anogona kupfuura kwaanoda. Pikicha ichiri kuvakwa pamwe chete.
Papepa, mumwe nomumwe anoshandisa pensiro imwe ndokudhirowa chimiro chake mumasikweya asina chinhu.

faq.q: Pane anokunda, taimbhi kana mabhodhi here?
faq.a: Kwete. Hapana anokunda, nekuti munovaka pikicha imwe pamwe chete. Hapana wachi, mabhodhi, kuverenga zvidimbu kana kurasikirwa. Unogona kumira nguva ipi neipi, uye kumira pakati pendima chinhu chakanaka chekupedzisa.

faq.q: Chinhu chatinovaka chinochengetwa here kana kutumirwa?
faq.a: Kwete. Gridhi inongogara papeji iri pano. Haichengetwi, haisimudzirwi kana kuverengwa, uye inopera kana wavharira peji. Kana uchida kuichengeta, dhinda gridhi uvake papepa.

faq.q: Kana ndaisa chidimbu panzvimbo isiyo?
faq.a: Hapana nzvimbo isiyo. Tapa "Dzosa chidimbu chekupedzisira" uye tsinhiro inodzoka kwauri. Unogona kudzosa sitepisi imwe panguva, uye kupfuura kunodzoserwa zvakare.

faq.q: Vanhu vane kusaona ruvara vanogona kusiyanisa mavara mana here?
faq.a: Akasarudzwa kuti vagone. Ruvara rwega rwega runewo zita rakanyorwa uye chimiro chayo chidiki mudidimbu rega rega, saka ruvara harisi chete nzira yekusiyanisa. Mavara mana akaongororwa nekuedza kwekusaona tsvuku nendarira uye buruu nemhiripiri. Munhu ane kusaona ruvara haasati aaedza, saka ndapota tiudze kana mavara maviri akafanana.

faq.q: Nzvimbo dzakakura zvakakwana here kune kudengenyeka kwemaoko kana skirini diki?
faq.a: Nzvimbo yega yega yakura zvakanyanya pamapikseli 56. Kana gridhi yakakura kupfuura skirini, inofamba kurutivi mubhokisi rayo pachayo panzvimbo pekudzikisa nzvimbo.

faq.q: Kune vhezheni yepapepa here?
faq.a: Hongu. "Dhinda gridhi" inodhinda gridhi isina chinhu papeji imwe ine mavara maviri namazita avo, kuti muvake nepensiro mbiri. Inoshanda mutsvuku nemutema nekuti ruvara rega rega rune chimiro chayo.

faq.q: Yakasununguka here, uye ndinoda kunyoreswa here?
faq.a: Ee, mahara, hauna akaundi, kunyoreswa kana kudawunirodha. Inoshanda pawebhusaiti yepawebhu pafoni, pathebhureti kana pakombiyuta.

seated-toss.name: Kukanda pasi pagaro
seated-toss.seoTitle: Kukanda Pasi Pagaro: Mutambo weBhegi Rembiti Vaviri
seated-toss.h1: Kukanda Pasi Pagaro: Kukanda Pamwe Patafura
seated-toss.description: Vanhu vaviri vakagara patafura vanotsinhirana kukanda bhegi rembiti rakapfava mukuru hwakakura uye vanochengeta tally papepa. Hapana nguva kana mapoinzi anoverengwa. Yakasununguka kudhinda.
seated-toss.short: Tsinhirai kukanda bhegi rembiti kune chinangwa chikuru, nekuverenga papepa.
seated-toss.intro: Mutambo wakanyarara wekukanda wevanhu vaviri vagere patafura. Unoisa chinangwa chakadhindwa patafura uye munotsinhirana kukanda bhegi rembiti rakapfava, kana sokisi yakapetwa, kuti rigere pamhete. Mumwe nomumwe wenyu anochengeta tally nekuita tiki mumabhokisi papepa, uye mopenya matiki pamwe chete pamunomira. Hapana nguva inoverengwa, hapana chinowedzerwa paskirini, uye hapana chinochengetwa kana kutumirwa. Ndapota verenga zvidzidzo zvekuchengetedza kutanga: zvinhu zvidiki zviri mukati zvinogona kuvharira mukosi.
howTo: Verenga zvidzidzo zvekuchengetedza. Sarudza bhegi rine chivharo chakabatanidzwa, kana pota sokisi yakachena.
Tapa "Dhinda chinangwa nepepa retally" uye isa pepa rakatsetseka patafura pakati penyu.
Garai zvakanaka, mumwe kumativi ega ega, uye tsinhirai nekukanda kumwe kwakapfava kwemumwe nemumwe. Mumwe wese anogona kupfuura.
Kana kukanda kwagara mumhete, itai tiki mubhokisi rekoramu yenyu, mumutsara wemhete iyoyo.
Mopenya matiki pamwe chete pamunomira, kana tapa Zorora kumisa kwechinguva.
tips: Garai pedyo zvakanaka kuti kukanda kwakapfava kusvike pachinangwa pasina kutambanudza.
Taurai nezvekukanda, kwete nezvemhedzisiro: “Ndiko kukanda kwakanaka.” Munhu wese anoshanyira kukanda kwese.
Sokisi yakakungurutswa inoremerera zvishoma uye iri nyore kubata, kunyanya kana kubata kuri kushaya simba. Isai ruoko patafura pakati pamakwikwi.
Kana munhu achida kungotarisa, anogona kuva iye anoisa chiratidzo mumabhokisi.

faq.q: Pane wachi kana mapoinzi here?
faq.a: Kwete. Hapana wachi, mapoinzi, kauntara yemisiyano kana kurasikirwa. Unogona kumira nguva ipi neipi, uye kumira uchiri pakati zvakanaka chaizvo sekupedzisa.

faq.q: Zvakachengeteka here kukanda bhegi rakazadzwa mbeu?
faq.a: Zvinogona kuva zvakachengeteka, nekungwarira. Shandisai bhegi rine chivharo chakasungwa kana sokisi yakakungurutswa, zvisingaiti mbeu dzakasununguka, mupunga kana zvinhu zvidiki zvakaisirwa mukati, nokuti izvi zvinogona kukonzera kuvharirwa kwemukoro kuvana vadiki nevanhu vanoisa zvinhu mumuromo. Garai pasi, kukanda pakati petafura zvishoma, musingakandi kuchiso, uye muve nemukuru ari pedyo.

faq.q: Pane chinhu chinoverengwa kana kuchengetwa pasikirini here?
faq.a: Kwete. Kuverenga kuri pamapepa chete, mumabhokisi amunozvizadzisa imi pachenyu. Peji iyi haichengeti kuverenga kana nguva, uye hapana chinochengetwa kana kutumirwa.

faq.q: Ko kana munhu asingakwanisi kukanda, kana bhegi risingagari pamapepa here?
faq.a: Munhu wese anogona kupfuura, uye bhegi rinowira kunze kwemapepa rinotorwa chete kuti rive kukanda kwerumwe rudzi. Hapana chinoverengwa nezvarwo.

faq.q: Chii chiri pamapepa akadhindwa?
faq.a: Peji imwe: chinangwa chikuru chine mhete dzacho dzitatu dzakanzi Pedyo, Pakati neKure, tafura ine kholamu yomunhu wese uye mutsara wemabhokisi madiki ekuisa chiratidzo pamhete imwe neimwe, pamwe nemutsara wezano rekuchengetedza. Mazita akanyorwa pamhete, saka zvinoshanda kana peji iri muchena nedema.

faq.q: Zvakasununguka here, uye ndinoda kunyoresa here?
faq.a: Hongu, zvakasununguka, uye hapana akaunzi, kunyoresa kana kudawunirodha. Zvinoshanda pawebhu brawuza pafoni, pathebhureti kana pakombiyuta.

seasonal-pack.name: Pakeji yemapuzzle emwaka
seasonal-pack.seoTitle: Pakeji yemapuzzle emwaka: Mapuzzle emapepa anodhindwa
seasonal-pack.h1: Pakeji yemapuzzle emwaka: Mapuzzle matatu emapepa pamwedzi wega wega
seasonal-pack.description: Mapuzzle madiki matatu anodhindwa emwedzi yega yega yegore: batanidza mapeya, tenderedza chinhu chakasiyana, uye pendanisa mufananidzo. Peji inovhurika nemwedzi uno, kana sarudza imwe, kana kuti zuva rekuzorora. Mahara ekudhinda.
seasonal-pack.short: Mapuzzle matatu anodhindwa emwedzi yaunosarudza, kana zuva rekuzorora.
seasonal-pack.players: Mazera ese, ari oga kana pamwe chete
seasonal-pack.intro: Sarudza mwedzi, uye peji inoratidza mapuzzle madiki matatu emapepa akatorwa pamifananidzo yemwedzi iwoyo: mizere miviri yekubatanidza nemitsara, mutsara wemana wekutenderedza chinhu chakasiyana, uye mufananidzo wekupendanisa. decorate-a-card.description: Vanhu vaviri vanoshongedza kadhi rekukwazisa rakadhindwa rekuzvarwa, rekutenda kana kungodaro, wobva vanyora meseji kumashure pamwe chete. Makrayoni kana pen chete. Hapana kauntara kana mapoinzi. Mahara ekudhinda.
decorate-a-card.short: Shongedzai kadhi rekukwazisa rakadhindwa pamwe chete.
decorate-a-card.intro: Mutambo wekuita wakadzika wevanhu vaviri vagere pamwe chete. Unodhinda peji imwe, inopetwa kuti ive kadhi. Sarudza mhemberero, senge zuva rekuzvarwa kana kutenda, uye shongedza divi rekutanga zvichitevera mashoko aro. Wobva wanyora meseji kumashure, pamwe chete, kana mumwe munhu achinyora zvinotaurwa nomumwe. Shandisai makrayoni, mapensiri ane ruvara kana pen dzine ruvara rwakanaka. Munhu mumwe anoshongedza rutivi rwekutanga, uye mumwe anoshongedza rwekumashure, kana kuti munotsinhanisa paruvara rumwe chete.
Nyorai shoko rekuti munyorere pamwe chete. Munhu mumwe anogona kunyora uku mumwe achitaura mashoko.
Mumire kana muchida. Kadhi rakapfava rinonakidza sekadhi rakaroorwa.

Chengeta kadhi munzvimbo inogona kupihwa, kana kungoisiya patafura kwapano.

find-together.seoTitle: Tsvaga Pamwe Chete: Vanhu Vaviri Vanotsvaga Mapaari
find-together.h1: Tsvaga Pamwe Chete: Vanhu Vaviri, Timu Imwe
find-together.description: Vanhu vaviri vanogovana sikirini imwe vachishandura kadhi mbiri dzemifananidzo nenhanho dzavo kuti vatsvage paari. Mapaari anowanikwa pamwe chete uye anoverengwa pane kauntanhamo imwe yakagovaniswa. Ibasa kutamba, pasina wachi kana mhedzisiro.
find-together.short: Shandurai nenhanho nomunhu ari padivi panu kuti muwane mapaari emifananidzo.
find-together.intro: Makadhi anotanga nemifananidzo yawo ichionekwa, kana mungaaisa akafukidzwa. Panhanho yenyu munoshandura makadhi maviri. Kana ari paari, mawana pamwe chete uye nhanho inopfuura. Kana akasiyana, anoramba akamuka kusvikira mapinda "Turn them back", kuti mose mone. Unogona kupfuura nguva ipi neipi. Kauntanhamo iri kumusoro inongokwira: mapaari amakawana pamwe chete.

Sikirini inoratidza kuti nhanho ndiyo yani, nedenderedzwa remunhu wekutanga uye sikweya yemunhu wechipiri.
Shandura makadhi maviri, imwe imwe nenguva. Kana akaenzana, paari yawanikwa pamwe chete.
Kana akasiyana, pinda "Turn them back" kana mose makagadzirira. Ipapo nhanho inopfuura.
Chero ani nani pakati penyu anogona kupinda "Pass" nguva ipi neipi. Tinya "Start again" kuti muwane makadhi matsva, kana tinya Rest kuti mumire.
tips: Garai padivi nepadivi muchitaura mifananidzo nemazwi pamwe chete: "Kapu yetii. Unodira mukaka mutii here?"
Regai munhu wamunorwira aite kutinya, kunyangwe zvichitora nguva. Ratidza nemunwe kwete kutinya iye.
Sarudza "Cards face down" kana imwe nemumwe wenyu achifarira kushandura makadhi kuti awane mifananidzo.
Munhu anoneta nekukurumidza anogona kupfuura kangani sokuda. Mapaari anoramba achiwanikwa pamwe chete.

garden-planner.name: Mupangi wesvondo
garden-planner.seoTitle: Mupangi wesvondo: Rongedza Nzvimbo Nemifananidzo Yemireza
garden-planner.h1: Mupangi wesvondo: Sarudza Mifananidzo Uite Rongedzo Renzvimbo
garden-planner.description: Sarudza mifananidzo yemireza nezvinhu zvesvondo, wozoziisa mumabhedi gumi nembiri enzvimbo. Dzvanya mufananidzo, wozodzvanya bhedi. Hapana nguva kana mavhoti. Mahara uye kudhinda zvakasununguka.
garden-planner.short: Sarudza mifananidzo yemireza uite rongedzo renzvimbo yemabhedi gumi nembiri.
garden-planner.intro: Sarudza mifananidzo kubva mutireyi yemireza nezvinhu zvesvondo, wozodzvanya bhedi kuti uise imwe neimwe panzvimbo yayo. Nzvimbo ine mabhedi gumi nembiri, uye bhedi rimwe rinobata mufananidzo mumwe. Muzvinyorwa zvishoma zvinotaura zvirimo mupango, somuenzaniso "Mupango wako une mirimo mitatu yezuva, mirasa miviri uye muti mumwe." Hapana chinoyerwa nenguva, chinoverengwa kana kuchengetwa, uye hapana kutsiva. Ndiro rerongedzo remifananidzo rekuti muhurukure nazvo, kwete zano rekudyara. "Dhinda mupango" rinodhinda mabhedi namifananidzo yamakasarudza, nemabhedi asina chinhu ekunyora mukati, nemitsara yemanotsi.
howTo: Dzvanya mufananidzo mutireyi. Unoratidza "Chasarudzwa" paunenge wasarudzwa.
Dzvanya bhedi. Mufananidzo unoenda ipapo, uye sarudzo inoiswa pasi.
Kuchinja bhedi, sarudza mufananidzo mumwe wodzvanya bhedi. Kubvisa bhedi, ridzvanye kana pasina mufananidzo wakasarudzwa.
Dzvanya "Tanga zvakare" kubvisa mabhedi ese, uye "Dzosa" kana ukachinja pfungwa.
Dzvanya "Dhinda mupango" kuti uwane kopi yepepa renzvimbo nezvinyorwa zvemupango.
tips: Nyatsotaura pikicha imwe neimwe painowiswa, somuenzaniso "muriwo unoiswa padyo nedzimba yehuku". Kutaura pamwe kunoita kuti iyi ibasa rinogovaniswa.
Ivai mumwe nomumwe anosarudza pikicha yake nepakavhurirwa, kana kuti musarudze pikicha pamwe chete, kuti vose vave nezvavanoita pamusoro pezvirongwa.
Papepa, mapindu asina chinhu chakanyorwa ndeekuti munyore mazano enyu, nemitsara yezvingamboita kuti mucherechedze chinhu chipi zvacho chamunoda kurangarira.

faq.q: Ndiyo pfungwa yekurima here?
faq.a: Kwete. Iyi ndiyo rongwa repikicha yekutaurirana, kwete zano rekudyara. Haitaure kuti chii chichidyarwa, nguva ipi, kana nzira ipi, nekuti izvi zvinoenderana nenyika yamunogara.

faq.q: Kune chiteshi chenguva, mapoinzi, kana mukhulu wekuhwina here?
faq.a: Kwete. Hapana chinoverengwa nenguva, chinoitwa mapoinzi, chinoongororwa, kana kuverengwa, uye hapana anohwina. Mapindu azara haaonekwi nemharidzo yakakosha.

faq.q: Mapikicha atisarudza anochengetwa kana kutumirwa here?
faq.a: Kwete. Rongwa iri rinogara paireji iyi chete. Haichengetwi, haisvikwi, uye haiverengwi, uye inopera kana mavhara peji.

faq.a: Ehe, mahara, uye hapana akaunzi, kunyoresa, kana kudhawunirodha. Inoshanda pawebhu mubhurawuza paserofoni, piritsi, kana komputa.

coloring-wall.name: Chidziro chekupenda chemapoka
coloring-wall.seoTitle: Chidziro Chekupenda Chemapoka: Pikicha Imwe Yemaoko Mazhinji
coloring-wall.h1: Chidziro Chekupenda Chemapoka: Pikicha Huru Imwe, Yakapendwa Pamwe Chete
coloring-wall.description: Dhinda pikicha huru imwe pamapeji akawanda, kuti mhuri, kirasi, kana imba yokuchengetera vanhu ivhenekere chidziro chimwe pamwe chete. Mahara kudhinda. Hapana nguva yekuverengwa kana mapoinzi.
coloring-wall.short: Dhinda pikicha huru pamapeji kuti vanhu vakawanda vaipende.
coloring-wall.intro: Sarudza pikicha kubva kumapeji ekupenda uye chidziro chemapeji 4, 6 kana 9. Dhinda chidziro: peji rekutanga rinoratidza kuti chinobatanidzwa sei, uye mamwe mapeji ese ndechikamu chimwe chepikicha imwe huru, nechiratidzo seA1 pakona yayo. Munhu mumwe nomumwe anopenda peji rimwe kana akawanda, nemavara nemaitiro asingazivikanwi. Mapeji anozobva aronganiswa nezviratidzo zvawo uye abatanidzwe netepi kumashure. Hapana chinoverengwa nenguva, mapoinzi, kana chinochengetwa.
howTo: Sarudza pikicha, wobva wasarudza kuti chidziro chine mapeji mangani.
Verenga mepu iri pascreen, inoratidza kuti chiratidzo chimwe nechimwe chinoenda kupi.
Dzvanya "Dhinda chidziro" uye udhinde mapeji ose.
Pa munhu mumwe nomumwe papeji rimwe kana akawanda kuti apende. Mavara nemaitiro haafanirwi kuenderana.
Ronganisa mapeji nezviratidzo zvawo, uye ubatanidze netepi kumashure.
tips: Pa mapeji ane mitsara iri nyore vanhu vanoda basa rakanyarara, uye akaoma kune anoda kuaona.
Isai chidziro pandinoonekwa nemunhu wese, uye ritaurei zvikamu pamwe chete.
Sarudza chidziro chidiki patafura diki, uye chikuru pakamuri.

faq.q: Kune chiteshi chenguva, mapoinzi, kana mukhulu wekuhwina here?
faq.a: Kwete. Hapana chinoverengwa nenguva, mapoinzi, kana kuverengwa, uye hapana anohwina. Chidziro chingova pikicha chete yakapendwa nevanhu vakawanda.

faq.q: Mapeji anochengetwa kana kutumirwa kupi here?
faq.a: Kwete. Chidziro chinogadzirwa papeji iri chete. Hachichengetwi, hachisvikwi, uye hachiverengwi, uye chinopera kana mavhara peji.

faq.q: Mavara anofanira kuenderana here?
faq.a: Kwete. Munhu mumwe nomumwe anogona kushandisa mavara nemaitiro aanoda. Mapeji achiri kubatanidzwa kuva pikicha imwe.

faq.q: Pane mhando yepepa here?
faq.a: Ehe. Chidziro chakadhindwa ndicho mutambo wose: peji rekutanga rine matanho nemepu, uye peji rimwe chikamu chimwe nechimwe chepikicha.

quiet-shapes.name: Puzzle yemifananidzo inonyarara
quiet-shapes.seoTitle: Puzzle Yemifananidzo Inonyarara: Isa Mifananidzo Mupikicha
quiet-shapes.h1: Puzzle Yemifananidzo Inonyarara: Isa Zvidimbu Mupikicha
quiet-shapes.description: Isa mifananidzo iri nyore mumutsara wedzimba, bhoti, hove nezvimwe. Dzvanya chidimbu, wobva wadzvanya nzvimbo ine chimiro chakafanana. Hapana nguva yekuverengwa kana mapoinzi. Mahara kutamba nekudhinda.
quiet-shapes.short: Isa mifananidzo iri nyore mupikicha, zvichitevera kukurumidza kwako.
quiet-shapes.intro: Mutsara wepikicha, sedzimba, bhoti kana rokete, wakakamurwa kuita nzvimbo. Nzvimbo imwe neimwe ine chidimbu chechimiro chakafanana, triangle huru kana diki, sikweya, parallelogram kana rectangle. Dzvanya chidimbu, wobva wadzvanya nzvimbo ine chimiro chakafanana, uye chinoenderana. Nzvimbo inotenderedza chidimbu chako, saka hapana chinofanira kudhirogwa kana kutenderedzwa. Kana chidimbu chine chimiro chakasiyana nenzvimbo, chinoramba muhomwe nenhungamiro pfupi. Hapana chinoverengwa nenguva kana mapoinzi, uye hapana chinochengetwa kana kutumirwa. "Dhinda mufananidzo uyu" inodhinda mutsara nezvidimbu papeji rimwe kuti upende kana kucheka.
howTo: Dzvanya chidimbu muhomwe. Chinoratidza "Chasarudzwa" kana chasarudzwa.
Dzvanya nzvimbo mupikicha. Kana chimiro chichienderana, chidimbu chinoisirwa ipapo.
Kana chisingaenderane, edza imwe nzvimbo. Hapana chinorasikirwa nekuedza.
Dzvanya chidimbu mupikicha kuchidzosera muhomwe, kana ushandise "Tanga zvakare" kuchidzosera zvese.
Nzvimbo dzose dzanechidimbu chadzo parinopera, pikicha yapera. Dzvanya "Mumwe mufananidzo" weimwe nyowani, kana dzvanya Zorora kuti umise.
tips: Washa mitsara yemutsetso kuti uone nzvimbo imwe neimwe. Vhara kuti pave nepuzzle yakanyanya, nekuti muchaona chimiro chete.
Tanga nemimwe mikuru, senge matrianguru makuru nemakona-makona. Zvidimbu zvidiki zvinowanzo kuiswa zvekupedzisira.
Taura mazita emimwe mimwe nenzwi guru sezvaunoenda: "triangle, square, rectangle yakareba". Kutaura kunogona kuita kuti ichive zvinhu zvemunhu ari mumwe chete.
Pamapepa, pendai zvidimbu nemivara miviri kana mitatu, kana kuti muzvicheke nemunhu mukuru achibatsira.

faq.q: Kune timer, mhedzisiro kana kuverenga kwemaitiro here?
faq.a: Kuti. Hapana chinoverengwa nenguva, hapana chinoverengwa kana kupihwa mapoinzi. Chidimbu chisingakwani chinongoregwa kunze, uye unogona kumira nguva ipi neipi.

faq.q: Chinhu chatinoita chinochengetwa kana kutumirwa here?
faq.a: Kuti. Mufananidzo unongogara pano pachikuva chino. Haucheng'etwi, haukwidziwi, uye hauverengwi; unopera kana ukavhara chikuva.

faq.q: Nzvimbo dzakakura zvakakwana here kune kudedera kwemaoko kana screen diki?
faq.a: Mugadziriro unoitwa wakakura sezvinobvumidzwa nescreen, uye nzvimbo imwe neimwe ibatani yaunogona kusvika nechigunwe kana nekiyi yeTab. Zvidimbu zviri mutray ndiwo mabatani makuru echikuva.

calm-breathing.name: Kufema Zvakanyorova
calm-breathing.description: Kumira kwakanyorova, kwakanaka kwekufema kugovana: denderedzwa rinokura uye rinodzika kwemafemo matanhatu. Iwe unotanga, uye unogona kumira nguva ipi neipi.
calm-breathing.short: Denderedzwa rinonyorova rekufema nariro. Tanga uye mira sezvaunoda.
calm-breathing.intro: Nguva dzimwe dzose mutambo wakanakisisa ndiko kumira kwakanyorova. Pinza "Tanga", wobva wafema mukati denderedzwa richikura uye kunze richidzika. Sarudza kufamba kwakanyanya kana kwakakurumidza. Haisi kurapwa, asi nguva yakanyorova yekugovana.
howTo: Garai pasi makomfoti pamwe chete.
Sarudza kufamba: kunyorova kana kwakanyanya.
Pinza "Tanga". Fema mukati denderedzwa richikura, uye kunze richidzika.
Rinomira rega rega pashure pemafemo matanhatu, kana pinza "Mira" nguva ipi neipi.
tips: Batana maoko kana uise ruoko pamaoko omunhu kana zvichifarirwa.
Usamanikidza. Kana vachida kungoona, zvakanaka.
Kana munhu ane dambudziko rekufema, fema zvakajairika uye ungotarisa denderedzwa chete. Bvunza chiremba pamusoro pechero dambudziko rekufema.

faq.q: Iri ndiro basa rekufema rekurapa here?
faq.a: Kwete. Ndiro kumira kwakapusa, kunoitwa kana uchida, nekuda kwerugare uye kuva pamwe chete. Haisi kurapwa kwekutya kana chirwere chipi zvacho. Taura nechiremba pamusoro penyaya dzehutano.

faq.q: Denderedzwa rinofamba here pasina kuti ini nditange?
faq.a: Kwete. Hapana chinofamba kusvika wadzanika Start, uye chinomira mushure mekufema kana matanhatu kana wadzanika Stop. Kana chishandiso chako chakagadzirwa kuderedza kufamba, mashoko anochinja asina denderedzwa kukura.

faq.q: Ndezvemahara here, uye ndinoda kunyoresa?
faq.a: Hongu, mahara, uye hapana akaunzi, kunyoresa kana kudhawunirodha. Unoshanda mu web browser pafoni, patablet kana pakombiyuta.

story-chain.short: Wedzera mufananidzo, wobva watanga chirevo chimwe chimwe, muchitevedzana.
story-chain.intro: Mutambo unotanga nemufananidzo mumwe uye unokura ketani nemufananidzo mumwe panguva. Munhu wega wega anotaura chirevo chimwe nezve ketani yacho kusvika parinhasi, nenzwi guru, muchitevedzana. Chirevo chinogona kunge chichitaura zvaunoona, nzvimbo inoyeuchidza, kana chinhu chinoseka. Hapana chinonyorwa, chinonyorwa kana kuchengetwa, hapana mhinduro yakanaka chaiyo, uye munhu wese anogona kupfuura. Ketani inomira pamifananidzo masere, ipapo unogona kutanga imwe itsva.

color-wash.name: Kusasa ruvara
color-wash.h1: Kusasa Ruvara: Pendesa Ruvara Rwakapfava Pamapeji
color-wash.description: Burashi rakapfava rinopenda mapeji akafara, akajeka emavara, mumavara mana uye saizi mbiri dzeburashi. Hapana pfuma, mapoinzi kana nguva. Mahara kutamba, hapana akaunzi.
color-wash.short: Pendesa kusasa kwakapfava kwemavara pamapeji, nekumhanya kwako.
color-wash.intro: Peji imwe nebhurashi rimwe rakapfava. Sarudza ruvara nesaizi yeburashi, wobva wakwidza pamapeji kuti uise kusasa kweruvara. Peji iyi haina pfuma: hapana chinhu chekupedza, hapana pikicha yekuwana zvakanaka, uye hapana mapoinzi. Isa kusasa kwakawanda sezvaunoda, kana kuisa burashi pasi uchingotarisa. Peji itsva inobvisa zvese, uye Dzosera inozvidzosa.
howTo: Sarudza ruvara. Ruvara rwega rwega rune zita rarwo rakanyorwa.
Sarudza Yakafara kana Yakafara Zvikuru. Yakafara Zvikuru inofukidza peji yakawanda nemutsara wega wega.
Kwidza pamapeji nomunwe, mouse kana peni kuti uise kusasa.
Kana kuti shandisa mitseve yemuseve kufambisa mhete yeburashi, uye Space kuisa burashi pasi kana kuibvisa.
Dzvanya "Peji itsva" kuti ubvise peji, wobva wadzvanya "Dzosera" kana uchida kusasa kwakadzokororwa.
tips: Rega mumwe munhu asarudze ruvara rwekusasa kunotevera, uye ngavataure nezvemavara sezvaanenge achiaisa.
Yakafara Zvikuru inonyanya kuvhara kana ruoko rwakasvibirira, nekuti burashi haridi kuva rakarurama.
Hapana nzira yakanaka yekupenda. Garai pandinodiwa, kana dzvanya "Zvapera panguva ino"."

faq.q: Pane kupedzisa, mapoinzi kana nguva here?
faq.a: Kwete. Peji haina pfuma. Hapana chinhu chinopedzwa, chinoverengwa, chinoyerwa nenguva kana kupiwa mapoinzi, uye hapana meseji inokukumbira kuti uite zvimwe.

faq.q: Peji inochengetwa here kana kutumirwa?
faq.a: Kwete. Hapana chinochengetwa, chinodhindwa kana kutumirwa kupi zvako. Kusasa kunogara papeji iyi kusvika wabuda.

faq.q: Ndingashandisa izvi pasina mouse kana sikirini inotsvaga here?
faq.a: Hongu. Peji ichiva nefocus, mitseve yemuseve inofambisa mhete yeburashi, uye kiyi yeSpace inoisa burashi pasi kana kuibvisa. Sikirini inoti "Burashi pasi" kana "Burashi kumusoro" nguva imwe neimwe.

faq.q: Pane vhezheni yepepa here?
faq.a: Kwete. Kupenda nevhatakara papepa ndiko kufanana, burashi rakanyorova uye ruvara rumwe panguva, saka ndiyo mhando yimwe yechiitwa chekuedza patafura.

faq.q: Mavara ndeapi?
faq.a: Yero, orenji, girinhi uye pepuru, mavara mana akafanana nemamwe mitambo yedu yemifananidzo. Rimwe nerimwe rine zita rakanyorwa, uye zita rinoratidzwa parutivi rwesarudzo.

faq.q: Ndeyemahara here, uye ndinofanira kunyoresa here?
faq.a: Hongu, mahara, uye hapana akaunzi, kunyoresa kana kudhawunirodha. Inoshanda mu browser yewebhu pafoni, piritsi kana komputa.
